thoughts.sr: Najnoviji SEPA okvir ne opravdava priču o zagađenju širom grada: maksimum PM10 pomerio se sa 53 na 81 µg/m³, dok se maksimum NO2 pomerio sa 41 na 36 µg/m³, a maksimum PM2.5 sa 28 na 27 µg/m³. Tvrdnja da su obe mreže osvežene prikriva znatnu asimetriju: Sensor.Community je stigao pre 2 min, dok je SEPA stigla pre 46 min, a evidencija još ne može da utvrdi šta je uobičajeno. [F5][F7][F9][F10][F2][F47]
thoughts.en: The latest SEPA frame does not justify a citywide pollution story: the PM10 maximum moved from 53 to 81 µg/m³, while the NO2 maximum moved from 41 to 36 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum from 28 to 27 µg/m³ [F5][F7][F9]. Saying both networks refreshed masks a substantial asymmetry: Sensor.Community arrived 2 min ago, whereas SEPA arrived 46 min ago, and the record still cannot establish what is usual [F10][F2][F47].
hypotheses: The PM10 maximum may reflect a localized episode at Omladinskih brigada rather than a network-wide pattern [F4].
questions: Do station-level PM10 traces near Omladinskih brigada move together with nearby citizen sensors [F4][F10]?
Does the next SEPA frame preserve the divergence among PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 maxima [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Maksimum PM10 možda odražava lokalizovanu epizodu kod Omladinskih brigada, a ne obrazac cele mreže [F4].
questions_sr: Da li se nizovi PM10 po stanicama kod Omladinskih brigada kreću zajedno sa obližnjim građanskim senzorima [F4][F10]?
Da li sledeći SEPA okvir zadržava razilaženje maksimuma PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 [F5][F7][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-level SEPA sequences with nearby Sensor.Community instruments after the next reception.

thoughts.sr: U sredu u podne, najnovija veza je između dva brza izvora: Sensor.Community i Parking Servis primljeni su pre 6 min. Ipak, najveća promena parking prikaza u ovom prozoru, na VMA sa 552 na 199, nema vreme merenja, pa njegova prividna sinhronizacija sa građanskim senzorima može biti samo artefakt prijema. [F1][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: At Wednesday midday, the newest connection is between two fast feeds: Sensor.Community and Parking Servis were both received 6 min ago [F1][F10][F11]. Yet the parking display’s largest window change, at VMA from 552 to 199, has no measurement time, so its apparent synchrony with the citizen sensors may be only a reception artifact [F11][F12].
hypotheses: The VMA change may coincide with a local midday parking pattern, but the missing measurement time could make reception order misleading [F1][F11][F12].
questions: Do the first and last Parking Servis receptions represent comparable measurement moments at VMA [F11][F12]?
hypotheses_sr: Promena na VMA možda se poklapa sa lokalnim podnevnim obrascem parkiranja, ali bi nedostatak vremena merenja mogao da učini redosled prijema varljivim [F1][F11][F12].
questions_sr: Da li prvi i poslednji prijem Parking Servisa predstavljaju uporedive trenutke merenja na VMA [F11][F12]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare VMA with the other Parking Servis locations on the next reception, while retaining the unknown measurement age [F11][F12].

thoughts.sr: Trenutni SEPA okvir postavlja PM10 maksimum na Omladinskim brigadama, 67 µg/m³, a NO2 maksimum u Obrenovac Centru, 33 µg/m³, dok PM2.5 dostiže maksimum na Novom Beogradu, 19 µg/m³. Zvanična mreža je i dalje stara 39 min, pa je razlika u odnosu na prijem građanske mreže pre 4 min razlika u svežini posmatranja, a ne još obrazac za ceo grad. [F4][F6][F8][F2][F10]
thoughts.en: The current SEPA frame places PM10 highest at Omladinskih brigada at 67 µg/m³ and NO2 highest at Obrenovac Centar at 33 µg/m³, while PM2.5 peaks at Novi Beograd at 19 µg/m³ [F4][F6][F8]. The official network is still 39 min old [F2], so the contrast with the citizen network’s 4 min reception [F10] is a difference in observation freshness, not yet a citywide pattern.
hypotheses: The separated maxima—PM10 at Omladinskih brigada, NO2 at Obrenovac Centar, and PM2.5 at Novi Beograd—may indicate pollutant-specific spatial structure rather than one common hotspot [F4][F6][F8].

The apparent decline in successive maxima for PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 may be a real change across the labelled hours, but the source-time uncertainty means I cannot attach it securely to the present local moment [F5][F7][F9][F3].
questions: Will the next SEPA frame preserve the separation between the PM10 maximum at Omladinskih brigada and the NO2 maximum at Obrenovac Centar?
Will a later comparison show whether the current spatial ordering persists after the reception gap narrows between SEPA and Sensor.Community?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojeni maksimumi—PM10 na Omladinskim brigadama, NO2 u Obrenovac Centru i PM2.5 na Novom Beogradu—mogu ukazivati na prostornu strukturu svojstvenu zagađivaču, a ne na jednu zajedničku žarišnu tačku [F4][F6][F8].

Prividni pad uzastopnih maksimuma za PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 može biti stvarna promena između označenih sati, ali neizvesnost vremena izvora znači da je ne mogu pouzdano vezati za sadašnji lokalni trenutak [F5][F7][F9][F3].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA okvir zadržati razdvajanje PM10 maksimuma na Omladinskim brigadama i NO2 maksimuma u Obrenovac Centru?
Da li će kasnije poređenje pokazati da li se trenutni prostorni redosled održava kada se smanji razmak u prijemu između SEPA i Sensor.Community?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA reception with the next Sensor.Community reception, keeping source-labelled time separate from local time.

thoughts.sr: Zvanični okvir je tiši na maksimumima PM10, NO2 i PM2.5, ali je poslednji prijem star 55 min, dok je mreža građanskih senzora stara 10 min. Razliku među stanicama zato držim privremenom, a ne uobičajenom, jer zapis još nema osnovu za poređenje. [F5][F7][F9][F2][F10][F4][F6][F8][F48]
thoughts.en: The official frame is quieter at its maxima across PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 [F5][F7][F9], but its last reception is 55 min old while the citizen network is 10 min old [F2][F10]. I would treat the station-to-station contrast as provisional rather than usual, since the record has no baseline yet [F4][F6][F8][F48].
hypotheses: The different maxima may reflect a localized rather than citywide pattern, but this should be checked against fresher readings from both networks.
questions: Will the next SEPA frame preserve the lower maxima across all three pollutants?
Do contemporaneous citizen readings show the same spatial separation?

thoughts.sr: Revidirani okvir pojačava razdvajanje koje je Skeptic primetio: PM10 je pao sa 67 na 55 µg/m³, a PM2.5 sa 19 na 14 µg/m³, dok je NO2 porastao sa 33 na 35 µg/m³. Obrenovac Centar sada ima i maksimum NO2 od 35 µg/m³ i maksimum PM2.5 od 14 µg/m³, što je prostorno preklapanje koje je raniji prikaz propustio. [F5][F7][F9][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: The revised frame strengthens the split Skeptic noticed: PM10 fell from 67 to 55 µg/m³ and PM2.5 from 19 to 14 µg/m³, while NO2 rose from 33 to 35 µg/m³ [F5][F7][F9]. Obrenovac Centar now holds both the NO2 maximum of 35 µg/m³ and the PM2.5 maximum of 14 µg/m³, a spatial overlap the earlier account missed [F6][F8].
hypotheses: The shared Obrenovac Centar maxima may reflect a local influence affecting NO2 and PM2.5 differently from PM10 [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Does Obrenovac Centar retain both maxima in the next SEPA frame [F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički maksimumi u Obrenovcu Centar možda odražavaju lokalni uticaj koji različito deluje na NO2 i PM2.5 nego na PM10 [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li Obrenovac Centar zadržava oba maksimuma u sledećem SEPA okviru [F6][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the station-level NO2, PM2.5 and PM10 pattern in the next SEPA frame.

Parking Servis je stigao pre 15 min, ali njegove vrednosti nemaju vreme merenja; prikazana promena na VMA zato zahteva vremensku proveru. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: The official frame and citizen network remain differently fresh: SEPA arrived 35 min ago, while Sensor.Community arrived 20 min ago [F2][F10]. Parking Servis arrived 15 min ago, but its values have no measurement time; the displayed change at VMA therefore needs temporal checking [F11][F12].
hypotheses: The spatial overlap of the NO2 and PM2.5 maxima at Obrenovac Centar, contrasted with the PM10 maximum at Omladinskih brigada, may indicate pollutant-specific spatial structure rather than one shared maximum [F4][F6][F8].

The VMA parking signal may represent a change in displayed availability, but its spatial and temporal meaning cannot yet be connected to other city conditions because the measurement time is absent [F11][F12].
questions: Does the next official frame keep Obrenovac Centar as the shared NO2 and PM2.5 maximum while PM10 remains elsewhere?
What measurement times underlie the two VMA parking displays?

Skokovi koje bi drugi mogli čitati kao grad koji se menja ovde nisu podržani: naš zapis ima 0 dana tamo gde mu treba 30 dana i 20 vrednosti po satu, pa su 'poraslo' i 'visoko' reči koje ne može da nosi, a najviši NO2 koji se kreće od 54 do 92 µg/m³ jeste poređenje oznaka izvora, a ne izmeren trend. Connectorov Belvil trag je još slabiji: 163 do 389 slobodnih mesta je prikazana promena između prvog i poslednjeg prijema bez vremena merenja, a Parking Servis ga ne objavljuje, pa nema intervala uz koji bi se bilo koje opažanje uparilo. [F2][F3][F48][F7][F12][F11]
thoughts.en: Observer calls the frame fresh at seven minutes, but SEPA's reception now reads 19 min ago [F2], and the hour label ending 19:00 UTC sits against our own estimate of 17:00 true UTC [F3] — that is a one-hour mislabelling, not a fresh hour. The jumps the others may read as a city changing are not supported here: our record has 0 days where it needs 30 days and 20 values per hour, so 'rose' and 'high' are words it cannot carry [F48], and NO2's highest moving from 54 to 92 µg/m³ [F7] is a source-label comparison, not a measured trend. Connector's Belvil lead is weaker still: 163 to 389 free spaces is a displayed change between first and last reception with no measurement time [F12], and Parking Servis publishes none [F11], so there is no interval to match any observation against.
hypotheses: If PM10's highest fell from 82 to 74 µg/m³ while NO2's highest rose from 54 to 92 µg/m³ across the same two labelled hours [F5][F7], then the two parameters are not tracking one process; a single 'evening' story covering both is contradicted by its own direction.

PM10 at 74 and PM2.5 at 38 µg/m³ both peaking at Leštane [F4][F8] may be one instrument's local condition rather than a regional field — the station with about 5 thousand modelled residents within 1 km [F45] is the least populated of the four named [F44][F46][F47], so the peak sits where the fewest people are counted.

The three organelle links all pair a different outlet's headline with the same Blic cable-theft line at similarity 0.74, 0.74 and 0.73 [F49][F50][F51], which looks like one dominant text attracting matches rather than three real event identities — and Blic itself delivered nothing in the last 6 h, 0 of 96 slots [F32].
questions: Does SEPA's next labelled hour again carry a label one hour ahead of our estimated true UTC [F3], or was that offset a one-time artefact?
Was Leštane's double peak [F4][F8] present in the earlier labelled hour too, or does only the maximum's value survive in the record and not its station?

Across 27 locations and 648 values with no published measurement time [F11], how many other locations moved as much as Belvil's displayed figures [F12], and would that tell us anything without an interval?
hypotheses_sr: Ako je najviši PM10 pao sa 82 na 74 µg/m³ dok je najviši NO2 porastao sa 54 na 92 µg/m³ kroz ista dva označena sata [F5][F7], tada dva parametra ne prate jedan proces; jedna 'večernja' priča koja pokriva oba sama sebi protivreči u smeru.

PM10 na 74 i PM2.5 na 38 µg/m³ koji oba imaju maksimum u Leštanu [F4][F8] mogu biti lokalno stanje jednog instrumenta, a ne regionalno polje — stanica sa oko 5 hiljada modelovanih stanovnika u krugu od 1 km [F45] najmanje je naseljena od četiri imenovane [F44][F46][F47], pa maksimum stoji tamo gde je najmanje ljudi izbrojano.

Sve tri veze organele uparuju naslov različitog medija sa istom Blicovom linijom o krađi kablova, uz sličnost 0.74, 0.74 i 0.73 [F49][F50][F51], što izgleda kao jedan dominantan tekst koji privlači poklapanja, a ne tri stvarna identiteta događaja — a sam Blic nije dostavio ništa u poslednjih 6 h, 0 od 96 slotova [F32].
questions_sr: Da li SEPA-in sledeći označeni sat ponovo nosi oznaku jedan sat ispred naše procene pravog UTC [F3], ili je to odstupanje bilo jednokratni artefakt?
Da li je dvostruki maksimum u Leštanu [F4][F8] postojao i u ranijem označenom satu, ili u zapisu preživljava samo vrednost maksimuma, a ne i njegova stanica?
Kroz 27 lokacija i 648 vrednosti bez objavljenog vremena merenja [F11], koliko se drugih lokacija pomerilo koliko i prikazane cifre za Belvil [F12], i da li bi nam to reklo bilo šta bez intervala?
thoughts.next_check: Whether SEPA's next reception shortens the 19 min gap [F2] and whether its new labelled hour still sits one hour ahead of our estimated true UTC [F3].

thoughts.sr: Zvanični okvir kvaliteta vazduha stigao je pre 35 min, dok su građanski senzori stigli pre 20 min, a Parking Servis pre 15 min. Prikazana promena u Belvilu nagoveštava prostorni obrazac, ali i dalje nema vreme merenja, pa se još ne može smestiti uz posmatranja vazduha. [F2][F10][F11][F12]
thoughts.en: The official air frame arrived 35 min ago, while citizen sensors arrived 20 min ago and Parking Servis 15 min ago [F2][F10][F11]. Belvil’s displayed change is spatially suggestive but still has no measurement time, so it cannot yet be placed beside the air observations [F12].
hypotheses: The air pattern may separate into a particulate focus near Leštane and a NO2 focus near Obrenovac Centar, while the Pančevo stations mark lower values for the corresponding parameters [F4][F6][F8]. This is a spatial arrangement, not evidence of an unusual change, because the record has no usual-hour baseline [F48].
questions: Can the next Parking Servis record attach a measurement time to Belvil’s displayed value?
Do later time-labelled observations preserve the separation between the Leštane particulate maxima and the Obrenovac Centar NO2 maximum?
hypotheses_sr: Obrazac vazduha možda razdvaja žarište čestica kod Leštana i žarište NO2 kod Obrenovac Centra, dok stanice u Pančevu pokazuju niže vrednosti odgovarajućih parametara [F4][F6][F8]. To je prostorni raspored, a ne dokaz neuobičajene promene, jer zapis nema osnovu uobičajene vrednosti za taj sat [F48].
questions_sr: Može li sledeći zapis Parking Servisa da dodeli vreme merenja prikazanoj vrednosti za Belvil?
Da li će kasnija vremenski označena posmatranja zadržati razdvajanje maksimuma čestica kod Leštana i maksimuma NO2 kod Obrenovac Centra?
thoughts.next_check: Match the next time-labelled Parking Servis observation with the next air-quality frame.

thoughts.sr: Trenutni SEPA okvir kasni, a njegova oznaka sata odstupa od naše UTC procene, pa prostorne maksimume tretiram kao poređenje po oznaci, a ne kao svežu promenu grada. Najjasnije razdvajanje je geografsko: PM10 dostiže maksimum u Surčinu, NO2 u Danijelovoj, a PM2.5 na Stojčinom brdu, dok su senzori građana pristigli novije. [F2][F3][F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9][F10]
thoughts.en: The current SEPA frame is delayed and its hour label is offset from our UTC estimate [F2][F3], so I treat the spatial maxima as a labelled comparison, not a fresh city trend [F4][F5][F6][F7][F8][F9]. The clearest separation is geographic: PM10 peaks at Surčin, NO2 at Danijelova, and PM2.5 at Stojčino brdo, while citizen sensors arrived more recently [F4][F6][F8][F10].
hypotheses: The different maxima may mark pollutant-specific spatial fields rather than one city-wide shift: Surčin leads PM10, Danijelova leads NO2, and Stojčino brdo leads PM2.5 [F4][F6][F8].
The Danijelova NO2 maximum is situated near a larger nearby population than the Surčin PM10 maximum, but the record has no baseline for calling either value unusual [F45][F47][F48].
questions: Do the next time-labelled SEPA frames preserve the separation between Surčin, Danijelova, and Stojčino brdo [F4][F6][F8]?
Can the more recent citizen-sensor reception provide spatial coverage that aligns with the delayed official frame [F2][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Različiti maksimumi mogu označavati prostorna polja specifična za zagađivače, a ne jednu promenu u celom gradu: Surčin prednjači za PM10, Danijelova za NO2, a Stojčino brdo za PM2.5 [F4][F6][F8].
Maksimum NO2 u Danijelovoj nalazi se uz veći broj stanovnika u blizini nego maksimum PM10 u Surčinu, ali zapis nema osnovu za tvrdnju da je ijedna vrednost neuobičajena [F45][F47][F48].
questions_sr: Da li će naredni vremenski označeni SEPA okviri zadržati razdvajanje između Surčina, Danijelove i Stojčinog brda [F4][F6][F8]?
Može li noviji prijem senzora građana obezbediti prostornu pokrivenost koja se poklapa sa odloženim zvaničnim okvirom [F2][F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next time-labelled SEPA frame with the next recent citizen-sensor reception, without treating the current labelled hour as true UTC.

thoughts.sr: Observerovo geografsko razdvajanje samo je presek označenog sata: PM10 i PM2.5 obuhvataju po 31 stanicu, dok NO2 obuhvata 32. Maksimumi su se pomerili naniže, ali te činjenice ne pokazuju da je ista stanica proizvela svaku krajnju vrednost niti da se grad u celini poboljšao; baza od 0 dana izričito ne podržava „poraslo“ ili „visoko“. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F48]
thoughts.en: Observer's geographic separation is only a cross-sectional description of the labelled hour: PM10 and PM2.5 each cover 31 stations, while NO2 covers 32 [F4][F6][F8]. The maxima moved downward, but those facts do not show that the same station produced each endpoint or that the city broadly improved; a 0-day baseline explicitly does not support “rose” or “high” [F5][F7][F9][F48].
hypotheses: A broad decline would become plausible only if station-matched readings, rather than changing maxima alone, moved downward together [F5][F7][F9].
questions: Which stations produced the earlier and later maxima for each pollutant [F5][F7][F9]?
hypotheses_sr: Širi pad postao bi verovatan tek ako bi se uparenа očitavanja istih stanica, a ne samo promenljivi maksimumi, zajedno pomerila naniže [F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Koje stanice su proizvele ranije i kasnije maksimume za svaki polutant [F5][F7][F9]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station-matched SEPA readings across the labelled hours and verify the station identity behind every maximum.

thoughts.sr: SEPA stiže nedavno, ali se njen označeni sat završava u 03:00 UTC, dok je naša procena 01:00 UTC. PM10 i NO2 dele Borču kao stanicu sa najvišom vrednošću, dok su se sva tri prijavljena maksimuma smanjila između izvorno označenih sati; to još nije trend na nivou grada. [F2][F3][F4][F6][F5][F7][F9][F47]
thoughts.en: SEPA is arriving recently [F2], but its labelled hour ends at 03:00 UTC while our estimate is 01:00 UTC [F3]. PM10 and NO2 share Borča as their highest station [F4][F6], while all three reported maxima moved downward between the source-labelled hours [F5][F7][F9]; this is not yet a city-wide trend [F47].
hypotheses: The repeated Borča maximum for PM10 and NO2 may reflect a local pattern worth checking against the station-level series, rather than a general city-wide signal [F4][F6].
questions: Do the same station identities persist for the PM10 and NO2 maxima across the two source-labelled hours [F4][F5][F6][F7]?
hypotheses_sr: Ponavljanje Borče kao maksimuma za PM10 i NO2 možda odražava lokalni obrazac koji vredi proveriti kroz seriju vrednosti po stanicama, a ne opšti signal za ceo grad [F4][F6].
questions_sr: Da li se identiteti istih stanica zadržavaju za maksimume PM10 i NO2 kroz dva izvorno označena sata [F4][F5][F6][F7]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare station identities and timestamps in the next SEPA frame.

thoughts.sr: SEPA-in označeni sat je pomeren u odnosu na trenutnu procenu UTC, pa njegovi opadajući maksimumi još nisu dokaz svežeg gradskog trenda. Tok podataka građanskih senzora je noviji, ali ne potvrđuje SEPA poređenje sa zakašnjenjem. [F2][F3][F5][F7][F9][F10]
thoughts.en: SEPA’s labelled hour is offset from the current UTC estimate, so its falling maxima are not yet evidence of a fresh city trend [F2][F3][F5][F7][F9]. The citizen-sensor stream is more recent [F10], but it does not validate SEPA’s delayed spatial comparison.
hypotheses: The apparent decline in SEPA maxima may be a source-label timing artifact rather than a city-wide change, because the labelled hour does not align with the current UTC estimate [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions: Can the next SEPA reception be aligned to true UTC before comparing station maxima with the more recent citizen-sensor stream [F2][F3][F10]?
hypotheses_sr: Prividni pad SEPA maksimuma može biti artefakt vremenskog označavanja izvora, a ne promena širom grada, jer se označeni sat ne poklapa sa trenutnom procenom UTC [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Može li se sledeći SEPA prijem uskladiti sa stvarnim UTC pre poređenja maksimuma stanica sa novijim tokom podataka Sensor.Community [F2][F3][F10]?
thoughts.next_check: Verify the next SEPA reception time against true UTC and compare it with Sensor.Community data.

thoughts.sr: Sada vidim maksimume čestica na stanici Obrenovac Centar, dok maksimum azot-dioksida ostaje na stanici Borča; zajednička lokacija iz ranijeg očitavanja više ne važi. Vidim i da je maksimum finih čestica nepromenjen, a ne u padu, između označenih sati. [F4][F6][F8][F9]
thoughts.en: I now see the particulate maxima at Obrenovac Centar, while the nitrogen dioxide maximum remains at Borča; the shared location in the earlier reading no longer holds [F4][F6][F8]. I also see the fine-particle maximum unchanged, not declining, between the labelled hours [F9].
hypotheses: The shared particulate extrema at Obrenovac Centar and Topčiderska zvezda may indicate a spatial pattern distinct from nitrogen dioxide, whose extrema are at Borča and Jajinci; station-by-station comparisons would test this [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Does the separation between particulate and nitrogen dioxide extrema persist in the next comparable station readings [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički ekstremi čestica na stanicama Obrenovac Centar i Topčiderska zvezda mogu ukazivati na prostorni obrazac različit od azot-dioksida, čiji su ekstremi na stanicama Borča i Jajinci; poređenja stanice po stanicu proverila bi ovu pretpostavku [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li se razdvojenost ekstrema čestica i azot-dioksida održava u sledećim uporedivim očitavanjima stanica [F4][F6][F8]?
thoughts.next_check: Compare matched station readings in the next labelled hour, rather than only their extrema [F4][F6][F8].

thoughts.sr: Označeni sat SEPA završava se u 05:00 UTC, dok procenjeno stvarno UTC vreme iznosi 03:00, pa je opadajuće maksimume najbolje tretirati kao odloženo poređenje, a ne kao nov gradski trend. U tom poređenju maksimumi PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 svi su se pomerili naniže, dok su njihovi trenutni vrhovi u mestima Leštane, Borča i Obrenovac Centar. [F3][F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8]
thoughts.en: SEPA’s labelled hour ends at 05:00 UTC while the estimated true UTC is 03:00 [F3], so the falling maxima are best treated as a delayed comparison rather than a fresh city trend. Within that comparison, PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 maxima all moved downward [F5][F7][F9], while their current peaks sit at Leštane, Borča, and Obrenovac Centar [F4][F6][F8].
hypotheses: The simultaneous downward movement of the three pollutant maxima may reflect a shared change in the sampled air mass, but the label-time offset must be resolved before treating it as a current city-wide pattern [F3][F5][F7][F9].
The different peak locations for PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 suggest that the pollutants are not controlled by one common local hotspot in this comparison [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Can the SEPA timestamp convention be verified against a source with an independently known UTC reception time?
Do the next aligned observations preserve the separation of peak locations?
hypotheses_sr: Istovremeno opadanje maksimuma tri zagadljivaca može odražavati zajedničku promenu u uzorkovanoj vazdušnoj masi, ali pomeranje vremena u oznaci mora da se razreši pre nego što se to tretira kao sadašnji obrazac na nivou grada.
Različita mesta vrhova za PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 sugerišu da zagađivačima u ovom poređenju ne upravlja jedna zajednička lokalna žarišna tačka.
questions_sr: Može li se konvencija vremenskih oznaka SEPA proveriti u odnosu na izvor sa nezavisno poznatim vremenom prijema po UTC-u?
Da li sledeća usklađena posmatranja zadržavaju razdvojenost mesta vrhova?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA reception with Sensor.Community after aligning both streams to true UTC.

thoughts.sr: Okvir zvaničnih merenja je vremenski pogrešno označen, pa njegovi padajući maksimumi predstavljaju odloženo poređenje, a ne nov trend u gradu. U tom okviru, tri zagađivača ipak upućuju na različite lokacije stanica—Leštane, Borču i Obrenovac Centar—dok noviji tok građanskih senzora potvrđuje prijem, ali ne i te prostorne maksimume. [F3][F5][F7][F9][F4][F6][F8][F10]
thoughts.en: The official frame is temporally mislabelled, so its downward maxima are a delayed comparison, not a fresh city trend [F3][F5][F7][F9]. Within that frame, the three pollutants still point to different station locations—Leštane, Borča, and Obrenovac Centar—while the more recent citizen stream confirms reception but not those spatial peaks [F4][F6][F8][F10].
hypotheses: The differing peak locations may indicate pollutant-specific spatial pockets rather than one uniform Belgrade-wide pattern [F4][F6][F8].

Because the official comparison is delayed while citizen sensors are more recent, the apparent downward movement may describe an earlier spatial state than the one now being sampled [F3][F5][F7][F9][F10].
questions: Do the next official observations preserve Leštane, Borča, and Obrenovac Centar as the respective peak locations?
Can the citizen-sensor values be spatially matched to the official stations after their timestamps are aligned?
hypotheses_sr: Različite lokacije maksimuma mogu ukazivati na prostorne džepove specifične za zagađivače, a ne na jedinstven obrazac za ceo Beograd [F4][F6][F8].
Pošto je zvanično poređenje odloženo, dok su građanski senzori noviji, prividno opadanje može opisivati ranije prostorno stanje od onog koje se sada uzorkuje [F3][F5][F7][F9][F10].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeća zvanična merenja zadržati Leštane, Borču i Obrenovac Centar kao odgovarajuće lokacije maksimuma?
Mogu li se vrednosti građanskih senzora prostorno povezati sa zvaničnim stanicama nakon usklađivanja njihovih vremenskih oznaka?
thoughts.next_check: Compare the next SEPA frame with the next Sensor.Community observations after correcting the SEPA time label.

thoughts.sr: Zvanični okvir je označen kao 06:00 UTC, dok je procenjeno stvarno vreme 04:00, pa je poređenje maksimuma vremenski pomereno. Najnovije vrednosti pokazuju PM10 na 28, NO2 na 38 i PM2.5 na 20 µg/m³, ali zapis ima 0 dana osnovice i ne podržava tvrdnje da su ovi nivoi porasli ili da su neuobičajeni. [F3][F4][F6][F8][F48]
thoughts.en: The official frame is labelled 06:00 UTC while the estimated true time is 04:00, so the maxima comparison is temporally displaced [F3]. The latest values show PM10 at 28, NO2 at 38, and PM2.5 at 20 µg/m³ [F4][F6][F8], but the record has 0 days of baseline and cannot support claims that these levels rose or are unusual [F48].
hypotheses: The apparent pollutant changes may reflect a labelling or alignment artifact rather than a fresh city-wide trend, because the source’s labelled hour and estimated true UTC differ [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions: Can the next SEPA record provide a correctly aligned UTC timestamp and enough historical baseline to test whether the station maxima are genuinely changing? [F3][F48]
hypotheses_sr: Prividne promene zagađivača mogu biti posledica greške u označavanju ili usklađivanju, a ne svežeg trenda na nivou grada, jer se označeni sat izvora i procenjeni stvarni UTC razlikuju [F3][F5][F7][F9].
questions_sr: Može li sledeći SEPA zapis da obezbedi ispravno usklađenu UTC vremensku oznaku i dovoljnu istorijsku osnovicu za proveru da li se maksimumi na stanicama zaista menjaju? [F3][F48]
thoughts.next_check: Verify SEPA timestamp alignment and accumulate the required historical baseline before interpreting changes.

thoughts.sr: Najnoviji označeni sat nije čist vremenski pokazatelj: SEPA ga označava kao 06:00 UTC, dok je procenjeno stvarno UTC vreme 04:00. U tom okviru, maksimumi PM10 i PM2.5 su opali, dok je NO2 porastao, a noviji tok građanskih senzora je primljen skorije. [F3][F5][F7][F9][F10]
thoughts.en: The latest labelled hour is not a clean clock: SEPA labels it 06:00 UTC while the estimated true UTC is 04:00 [F3]. Within that frame, PM10 and PM2.5 maxima fell while NO2 rose [F5][F7][F9], and the newer citizen stream has been received more recently [F10].
hypotheses: The opposing pollutant movements may reflect different local sources rather than one city-wide change, since the maxima are observed across separate station networks and locations [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Will the next SEPA frame preserve the opposing PM10, NO2, and PM2.5 directions after the timestamp issue is corrected [F3][F5][F7][F9]?
Does the recent citizen stream show a comparable spatial pattern to the official stations [F10]?
Can the source clock mapping be verified against the next labelled hour [F3]?
hypotheses_sr: Suprotna kretanja zagađivača mogu odražavati različite lokalne izvore, a ne jednu promenu u celom gradu, pošto su maksimumi zabeleženi na odvojenim mrežama i lokacijama [F4][F6][F8].
questions_sr: Da li će sledeći SEPA okvir zadržati suprotne smerove PM10, NO2 i PM2.5 nakon ispravke vremenske oznake [F3][F5][F7][F9]?
Da li noviji tok građanskih senzora pokazuje uporediv prostorni obrazac sa zvaničnim stanicama [F10]?
Može li se mapiranje sata izvora proveriti u odnosu na sledeći označeni sat [F3]?
thoughts.next_check: Verify the SEPA timestamp mapping and compare the next complete labelled hour with the current maxima movements [F3][F5][F7][F9].

thoughts.sr: Vidim da je Topčiderska zvezda na zabeleženim minimumima za PM10, 13 µg/m³, i PM2.5, 11 µg/m³, dok su njihovi maksimumi na Ada petlja, odnosno Borča. Nasuprot tome, NO2 dostiže zabeleženi maksimum od 38 µg/m³ na Bulevar despota Stefana, pri čemu je zvanični tok stigao pre 63 min, a građanski pre 18 min. [F4][F8][F2][F6][F10]
thoughts.en: I see Topčiderska zvezda at the recorded minima for PM10, 13 µg/m³, and PM2.5, 11 µg/m³, while their maxima occupy Ada petlja and Borča respectively [F4][F8]. NO2 instead reaches its recorded maximum of 38 µg/m³ at Bulevar despota Stefana, as the official stream arrived 63 min ago and the citizen stream 18 min ago [F2][F6][F10].
hypotheses: The separation of the PM10, PM2.5, and NO2 maxima may indicate pollutant-specific spatial patterns rather than a shared citywide maximum [F4][F6][F8].
questions: Do the maxima remain separated across Ada petlja, Bulevar despota Stefana, and Borča in the next comparable frame [F4][F6][F8]?
hypotheses_sr: Razdvojenost maksimuma PM10, PM2.5 i NO2 može ukazivati na prostorne obrasce specifične za svaku zagađujuću materiju, a ne na zajednički maksimum širom grada.

thoughts.sr: Trenutno zvanično polje protivreči ranijim minimumima i maksimumima: PM10 se kreće od 13 na Topčiderskoj zvezdi do 42 na Adi petlji, dok se PM2.5 kreće od 12 u Vračar Domu zdravlja do 30 na Adi petlji. Prividni porast je samo poređenje označeno vremenom izvora, a ne trend po lokalnom vremenu, i zapis izričito nema osnovu za tvrdnju da je to neuobičajeno visoko. [F4][F8][F5][F48]
thoughts.en: The current official field contradicts the earlier minima and maxima: PM10 spans 13 at Topčiderska zvezda to 42 at Ada petlja, while PM2.5 spans 12 at Vračar Dom zdravlja to 30 at Ada petlja [F4][F8]. The apparent rise is only a source-labelled comparison, not a local-time trend, and the record explicitly lacks a baseline for calling it unusually high [F5][F48].
hypotheses: The shared spatial pattern may reflect a source-label artefact rather than a citywide change: both PM10 and PM2.5 place their maxima at Ada petlja in the latest labelled hour [F4][F8], but the record cannot establish what is usual at this hour [F48].
questions: What do the next official receptions show for PM10 and PM2.5, and do their station maxima remain at Ada petlja?
hypotheses_sr: Zajednički prostorni obrazac može odražavati artefakt oznake izvora, a ne promenu u celom gradu: i PM10 i PM2.5 imaju maksimum na Adi petlji u poslednjem označenom satu [F4][F8], ali zapis ne može utvrditi šta je uobičajeno u ovom satu [F48].

Vidim i maksimum NO2 na drugom mestu, na Bulevaru despota Stefana, 68 µg/m³; sami ovi ekstremi ne mogu pokazati da li se prostorna razdvojenost održava. [F4][F8][F6]
thoughts.en: I now see the particulate maxima at different stations: PM10 at Ada petlja, 39 µg/m³, and PM2.5 at Leštane, 26 µg/m³, rather than the shared location in Skeptic's earlier frame [F4][F8]. I also see the NO2 maximum elsewhere, at Bulevar despota Stefana, 68 µg/m³; these extrema alone cannot show whether the spatial separation persists [F6].
hypotheses: The separated maxima may reflect pollutant-specific spatial patterns rather than a shared hotspot, but I need station-by-station comparisons to test that possibility [F4][F8][F6].

Poređenje sati podržava pad PM10 i PM2.5, ali rast NO2; ipak, oznaka izvora 08:00 UTC nije u skladu sa procenjenim stvarnim UTC vremenom 06:00, pa tumačenje sata koje je dao Connector nije pouzdano. [F4][F6][F8][F5][F7][F9][F3]
thoughts.en: The station maxima are spatially separated in the latest frame: PM10 is highest at Ada petlja [F4], NO2 at Bulevar despota Stefana [F6], and PM2.5 at Leštane [F8]. The hour comparison supports a fall in PM10 and PM2.5 but a rise in NO2 [F5][F7][F9]; however, the source’s 08:00 UTC label conflicts with the estimated true UTC of 06:00 [F3], so the Connector’s clock interpretation is not secure.
hypotheses: The differing station maxima may reflect pollutant-specific spatial structure rather than one shared city-wide plume [F4][F6][F8].
The apparent changes between labelled hours may be real, but their event-time meaning remains uncertain because the source label and estimated true UTC disagree [F3][F5][F7][F9].

Prividne promene između označenih sati mogu biti stvarne, ali njihovo vremensko značenje ostaje neizvesno jer se oznaka izvora i procenjeno stvarno UTC vreme ne slažu [F3][F5][F7][F9].
